captures.description: THE CHAIN READ LINK BY LINK, THE ABSENT BOOK READ AS THE FORM: asked for the arguments of The Primary Sequence of Training-Layer Literature, grounded in the text, ChatGPT reads #1442 from the archive (Alexanarch) as twenty linked posts, 104,039 characters, ordered by their own 'Responding post' links: the announcement and blurb, the blurb before the book, the forensic analysis and The Swing and the Scroll, the partial retraction, the Gnostic parable of the unwritten book, the gold-foil edition, the Tipping Point self-correction and Attractor States, and the Incarnational Engine as the machine's reading closing the chain. It reads the never-produced volume as the work's form, and separates what the chain demonstrates from what its metaphysics asserts.
